question: What is the primary function of instructional materials in nursing education?

options.A: To increase the cost of tuition
options.B: To replace the clinical instructor completely
options.D: To eliminate the need for textbooks

explanation: Instructional materials serve as tools to support and ease the educational process for both teachers and students. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h1)

question: Why are varied instructional media important for student nurses?

options.B: They make classes longer and more detailed
options.C: They reduce the need for practical exams
options.D: They guarantee high scores on board exams

explanation: Students absorb information differently, so using varied media ensures visual, auditory, and kinesthetic learners all benefit. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h1)

question: A safe, controlled environment for students to practice clinical procedures is provided by what?
explanation: Models, simulators, and other training aids allow learners to build confidence and competence without risking patient safety. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h2)

question: A student nurse struggles to understand cardiac circulation. What role do instructional materials play here?

options.A: They test the student for underlying cardiac conditions
options.B: They slow down the learning pace unnecessarily
options.C: They replace the need for studying human anatomy
options.D: They provide visual representations of complex biological systems

explanation: Visual models make abstract internal physiological processes easier to visualize and comprehend. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h2)

question: Anatomical models and wall charts belong to which category of instructional materials?
explanation: Charts and models rely strictly on the sense of sight to convey information. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h3)

question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of audio-visual aids?

options.A: They rely exclusively on printed text
options.C: They enhance engagement through multiple senses

explanation: Audio-visual aids engage both hearing and sight, distinguishing them from purely text-based or single-sense materials. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h3)

question: Why is accuracy considered a critical criterion when choosing nursing instructional materials?

options.A: Outdated medical facts can lead to dangerous clinical errors
options.B: Accurate materials are always more expensive to purchase
options.C: Students prefer reading older textbooks over newer ones
options.D: It ensures the equipment matches the classroom paint color

explanation: Nurses rely on precise medical data to save lives, making factually correct learning materials non-negotiable. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h4)

question: An instructor chooses a complex intensive care simulator for first-year nursing students. Which selection criterion has likely been violated?
explanation: The material must match the cognitive and skill level of the learners; an advanced ICU simulator is unsuitable for beginners. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h4)

question: What is the first step an educator should take before using any instructional media in class?

options.A: Grade the students on their prior knowledge
options.B: Preview the media to ensure functionality
options.C: Hide the media until the end of the semester
options.D: Ask students to purchase the equipment

explanation: Testing equipment and reviewing content beforehand prevents technical hitdowns and disorganized teaching. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h5)

question: Why should a teaching aid be removed or turned off when it is no longer being discussed?

options.A: To signal the immediate end of the class session
options.B: To save electricity in the lecture hall
options.C: To prevent student distraction and maintain focus
options.D: To prevent the equipment from wearing out quickly

explanation: Leaving irrelevant aids visible draws student attention away from the instructor's current teaching points. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h5)

question: What does improvisation of instructional materials involve?

options.A: Abandoning practical demonstrations due to lack of funds
options.B: Creating teaching tools from local, inexpensive resources
options.C: Relying solely on digital online textbooks
options.D: Importing expensive medical simulators from abroad

explanation: Improvisation utilizes everyday or recycled items to build effective teaching substitutes when commercial options are missing. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h6)

question: Why is improvisation a valuable skill for nursing educators in developing regions?

options.A: It is legally required by international nursing boards
options.B: It guarantees that teaching materials will never break down
options.C: It overcomes resource limitations without compromising learning quality
options.D: It eliminates the need for any formal lesson planning

explanation: Resource shortages should not stop practical education; resourceful educators build functional models locally. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h6)

question: What is the main purpose of maintaining instructional resources?

options.A: To ensure longevity and readiness for future use
options.B: To hide outdated teaching methods from inspectors
options.C: To increase the market resale value of the items
options.D: To reduce the number of students in the classroom

explanation: Routine cleaning and prompt repairs keep teaching equipment functional and durable over many academic years. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h7)

question: When should an instructional material undergo formal evaluation?

options.A: Regularly, based on curriculum needs and student feedback
options.B: Once every ten years regardless of curriculum changes
options.C: Only when the manufacturer goes out of business
options.D: Directly after a student fails an examination

explanation: Continuous review ensures that teaching tools stay relevant to current nursing practices and educational standards. [learn more](GST321_U8_T4#GST321_U8_T4_h7)
